events.info: All Ages Event. Doors open at 7PM. Show starts at 8PM. Scheduled Support: Turnaways. To purchase tickets on the day of the event after 5PM, please visit the House of Blues Box Office at the venue located at 2200 North Lamar Street in Dallas. The Box Office is open 2 hours prior to door time on show days. Closing hours vary per event. All sales are subject to increase the day of the show. Support acts are subject to change without notice.
